title: Backscatter Bicyclist
text: Backscatter signals from bicyclist, 5 inputs, 4 outputs, {Azimuth angles (deg)} sets Azimuth angles; {Number of wheel spokes} sets the number of spokes per wheel, {Gear transmission ratio} sets the ratio of wheel rotations to pedal, {Signal carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the carrier frequency 77e9, {Initial position (m)} sets the initial position of bicyclist, {Initial heading direction (deg)} sets the initial heading of bicyclist, {Initial bicyclist speed (m/s)} sets the initial speed of bicyclist, {Propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {RCS pattern}, {Elevation angles (deg)} sets the elevation angles, {Radar cross section pattern (square meters)} sets the radar cross-section pattern 1-by-361 real-valued and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Incident radar signals complex-valued M -by- N matrix

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: Directions of incident signals real-valued 2-by- N vector

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Combined reflected radar signals complex-valued M -by-1 column vector

ports.name: Pos
ports.summary: Positions of scatterers real-valued 3-by- N matrix

params.name: Number of wheel spokes
params.values: Number of spokes per wheel 20 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Gear transmission ratio
params.values: Ratio of wheel rotations to pedal rotations 1.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial position (m)
params.values: Initial position of bicyclist [0;0;0] (default) | 3-by-1 real-valued vector

params.name: Initial bicyclist speed (m/s)
params.values: Initial speed of bicyclist 4 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | positive scalar

params.name: RCS pattern
params.values: Source of RCS pattern Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Azimuth angles (deg)
params.values: Azimuth angles [-180:180] (default) | 1-by- P real-valued row vector | P -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: Elevation angles (deg)
params.values: Elevation angles [-90:90] (default) | 1-by- Q real-valued row vector | Q -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: Radar cross section pattern (square meters)
params.values: Radar cross-section pattern 1-by-361 real-valued matrix (default) | Q -by- P real-valued matrix | 1-by- P real-valued vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
